centroid_notes: Each refresh is executed under EXPLAIN ANALYZE; SPI work may not be individually visible in the plan. Source tuple counters cover same-transaction sequential returns and index fetches, including repeated visits, during the refresh. Group rescan, algebraic and FULL run in that order. WAL excludes the source mutation; auxiliary bytes are logical payload estimates.

centroid_repeated.notes: Each round changes one source vector; group and strategy order rotate. Times cover the refresh call without EXPLAIN, mutation or validation. No warmup, concurrent load, or repeated rebase measurements.

postgres: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg12+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 12.2.0-14+deb12u1) 12.2.0, 64-bit

refresh.notes: Separate equivalent HNSW indexes; differential always runs first; WAL is cluster-wide between LSN reads and excludes source mutations
